excluded_bases.pa_t011_t011_o003_p01: seen in payer intake development and validation preparation

execution_path.formal_harbor_condition: Only if all formal supply/CLI/state/patient/authorization conditions are separately met; may combine evidence in the same run but must not claim mock assembly as real Harbor.
execution_path.label: development unseen validation, not formal Harbor

resource_supply_matrix.credentials: runtime injects only OPENCODE_API_KEY; no judge or other provider credentials
resource_supply_matrix.handbook: restricted managed-care handbook supplied read-only by authorized caller; not redistributed
resource_supply_matrix.instruction: caller supplies the public instruction file for each task; not copied from hidden material
resource_supply_matrix.mcp: one role MCP endpoint per task (provider 8020, payer 8100, CM 8200), new world
resource_supply_matrix.patient: CM development Go simulator only for development path; official Anthropic patient path requires separate supply/authorization
resource_supply_matrix.state_logs: new external evaluation state and isolated logs; no old accounting/pending/receipt reuse
resource_supply_matrix.tool_reference: caller supplies the public tool_reference file; normal regular file only
resource_supply_matrix.world: official task world asset supplied by authorized caller; exact path/hash frozen when acquired

selection_method: Read only the public data/tasks.jsonl index fields (family, task_id, path, title, task_kind, actor, timeout, public fixture counts, public URLs). Ignore expected_target_status, expected_payer_route and verifier_contract. Exclude bases seen in prior reports/docs; then sort task_id ascending and take the first three provider, first three UM with bases disjoint from provider, and first three CM excluding the seen CM task. No result-based substitution.
